apps.name: CastCorner
apps.short_description: Bring your 2D sprite avatars to life directly above your full-screen games and desktop apps. With real-time voice reactivity, CastCorner gives your stream, videos, or everyday gaming session a unique, personal touch.

apps.name: CoyoteMIDI: MIDI To Key
apps.short_description: Turn any MIDI device into a fully programmable hotkey board. Bind any key, knob, or pad to keyboard shortcuts, macros, and mouse clicks for total control over your games and apps directly from the device.

apps.name: nofio wireless adapter for Valve Index
apps.short_description: Introducing nofio, a leading hardware company delivering high-performance, immersive hardware. With unmatched image quality and ultra-low latency, our products unlock true immersive experience.

apps.name: Rexclaw Companions
apps.short_description: Rexclaw is a open-source crew of VRM companions living on your desktop. Chat by text and voice, they remember, react in real time, take selfies, and can see your screen. Join them in Minecraft, or meet them in your own room in VR. Cloud AI features require internet connection and a rexclaw account.

apps.name: Al Potato - Nowhere near Vegas Playtest
Green Brigade Operation Green Dawn Playtest
Iron Hunters Playtest
apps.short_description: Pilot customizable mechs in this roguelite packed with chaotic bullet-hell combat. Upgrade, evolve, and combine weapons mid-run to build game-breaking synergies as you hunt down criminals across alien worlds.

apps.name: A Walk to the Stars Demo
A Webbing Journey Demo
apps.short_description: Adorable spider chaos! Swing around the house, weave crazy structures, play with physics-based objects, and pull off chores with nothing but your webs and your wits in this madcap sandbox adventure.

apps.name: Aethermancer Demo
apps.short_description: Monster Taming meets Roguelite. Become the Aethermancer and fight alongside mythical creatures. Explore the ever-changing Fractured Ruins, plan your moves in challenging turn-based battles, and watch your Monsters grow stronger from previous lives and defy death!

apps.name: DABANGGU Demo
apps.short_description: Play a complete round of Korean alleyway team tag with bots in Ikseon-dong. Run, disguise yourself as street props, outsmart the taggers, and break every captured teammate out of base.

apps.name: Emblems: Sunless Vow Demo
apps.short_description: Unravel a mystery where you know the outcome from the start…in this turn-based roguelite RPG. A strange mage and his two captives must regain their memories to escape from a hostile void. But can they stop *arguing* first? A playful character drama with unusual combat.

apps.name: End of End Demo
apps.short_description: Loot and fight your way through this roguelite dungeon crawler set in the land without a sun. Unlock powerful items and abilities to build unstoppable combinations. Cleanse dungeons, ruins, and the wild spaces of End from the evil that has returned to claim it.

apps.name: Feed the Scorchpot Demo
apps.short_description: A dice roguelike about feeding a dragon for twenty years. Roll ingredients, build your island, and fuse absurd recipes into combos that break the score wide open. Miss a meal and you're next on the menu.

apps.name: Flame Cycle Demo
apps.short_description: A soulslike open world, where the map constantly changes and your deck is your only anchor

apps.name: From The Void Demo
apps.short_description: Command a fleet of customizable spaceships, go through intense battles and create builds with unique synergies. Think your placements and upgrades as they will shape the fleet's fate and determines victory or defeat. Test your strategic skills in this rogue-like autobattler game.

apps.name: Gacha Chaos Tidy Up Together Demo
apps.short_description: A cozy-chaotic co-op organizing sim. Sort 7,200 gacha capsules into 900 machines across 20 color zones, solo or with 1-4 players. Throw, catch, and SLAP capsules out of your friends' hands, unlock 13 team skills, and collect 100 capsule series. No timer, just chaos.

apps.name: Genesis: Voces de la Niebla (Voices of the Mist) Demo
apps.short_description: Genesis: Voces de la Niebla es una experiencia de horror psicológico en tercera persona, centrada en la exploración, la atmósfera y la narrativa ambiental.

apps.name: Hamstr Protocol Demo
apps.short_description: Get hands-on with Hamstr Protocol. Build your first bio-mining rig by hand, put your hamster to work, manage heat, and mine your first HAM. Start your operation and discover what it takes to keep everything running.

apps.name: Heart Stealer Demo
apps.short_description: A fantasy romance visual novel where you play a witch sent to the human world for one semester. Befriend and romance seven humans, collect Amor energy through your choices, and decide how much love you can afford to give. Free demo covers Days 1–10.

apps.name: Hex Tower Boogie Demo
apps.short_description: Try the Hex Tower Boogie demo: build ammo chains, keep your towers firing, and join the fight with your own launcher. Tower defense, factory building and direct action on a colorful 3D hex board, with online matches for up to four players and bots.

apps.name: Hollow Sky Demo
apps.short_description: Create your character and experience 10 minutes of the opening story, combat, and upgrades. The full game is a sandbox open world with survival, missions, bosses, vehicles, cities, and underground areas. Wishlist now!

apps.name: Hopfall Demo
apps.short_description: Build your team in this froguelite autobattler. Tame corrupted frogs, equip them with powerful items, and discover team synergies to overcome mysterious enemies.

apps.name: Knights Within Demo
apps.short_description: Knights Within is a 1-3 player blend between third person shooter and melee hack&slash with roguelite elements. Design custom loadouts, navigate procedurally generated levels and utilize random power-ups. Can you survive endless waves of enemies to ensure humanity's survival?

apps.name: Lost In Socks Demo
apps.short_description: The washing machine exploded and socks are everywhere! Grab, throw, wash and pair your way through a chaotic physics-based laundry adventure. Play solo or team up with up to three friends in online co-op. Try the Small House for free!

apps.name: LSDos: Digital Simulation Simulator (Demo)
apps.short_description: LSDos is a weirdcore-inspired, open-world exploration game where you are trapped in a computer, searching for any way to escape. Complete tasks and do an abundance of things to acquire the tools and expertise needed to leave safely.

apps.name: MineMergeMatic Demo
apps.short_description: Mine, merge, and automate! Combine ores into valuable resources, build compact production chains, unlock powerful machinery, and expand your cave into a bustling mining factory.

apps.name: Overbuffed Demo
apps.short_description: A dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder with auto-battler combat. Build your deck, summon creatures, upgrade your weapon, and fight your way through floors filled with ever-deadlier enemies. Every run is different. Every mistake can be fatal.

apps.name: President FC: Football Club Owner Demo
apps.short_description: Create a football club and run its first season as the owner in this free demo. Hire your manager, scout players, explore the academy and decide where to invest. Leave the team to your manager or step in before each match. Your save carries over to the full game.

apps.name: runz Demo
apps.short_description: RUNZ is a game where every bullet in your magazine matters. Survive as the waves get harder, and master an original upgrade system. Build synergies, combine bullets, manage your economy and upgrade your gun in this twin-stick shooter with auto-battler elements.

apps.name: Safe Zone: A Cozy Post-Apocalyptic Game Demo
apps.short_description: Take a break from the end of the world. In Safe Zone, build and decorate the coziest post-apocalyptic shelter you can imagine. Welcome weary survivors, take care of their needs, discover their stories, and help them find a new place in a world forever changed.

apps.name: Save the Nuke! Demo
apps.short_description: Save the nuke.....with a gun!

apps.name: Shadow Pulse Demo
apps.short_description:
Escape from creepy monsters and avoid deadly traps in the 2D horror adventure Shadow Pulse.
Stealth and speed are your best weapons. Madness and death await at every turn. Will you be able to unravel the mysteries of this post-apocalyptic world?

apps.name: Sincerely, Your Diary Demo
apps.short_description: A quiet autumn evening in a small seaside town. The soft flicker of a monitor, drizzle outside, and your favorite tracks playing in your headphones. A simple "hi" from a stranger breaks the quiet. What starts as a chat to pass the time becomes a fragile thread connecting two very different worlds...

apps.name: Team Rush Demo
apps.short_description: Team Rush is a fast-paced multiplayer beat-'em-up built around fluid movement, creative combos, and high-energy battles. In this beat-'em-up choose from a diverse cast of fighters, each with their own unique abilities, special attacks, and playstyles.

apps.name: The Fog Below Demo
apps.short_description: An ASCII-style endless arcade crawler. Using a unique Minesweeper-inspired reveal mechanic to navigate random generated dungeons while engaging in frantic, high-speed arcade combat.

apps.name: The Knight of Turn Demo
apps.short_description: A turn-based tactical puzzle with the soul of a board game. Plan every move, master swords, shields, arrows, and magic, escape the dungeons, and free the Kingdom of Abalgrade from the invading Druuls.

apps.name: The Maze Wars Demo
apps.short_description: The Maze Wars is an FPS survival game. Fight through deadly skeleton enemies, travel between portals, and find your way out of the labyrinth!

apps.name: Tidy Botanical Demo
apps.short_description: Clear a junk-filled city lot and bring it back to life, one plank, one soil bag and one seed at a time. Play solo or team up with a friend as the Builder and the Gardener in this cozy co-op tidying game. No timers, no pressure, just green.

apps.name: VacBot Simulator Demo
apps.short_description: Have you ever wondered what your robotic vacuum feels when it's wandering through your house? Picking up your messes, leaving your floors pristine again. Wonder no more! Experience the joys of cleaning various houses through the LIDARs of several judgemental robotic vacuums.

apps.name: Village of the Ages Demo
apps.short_description: If a giant tornado ended it all, can you rebuild? Guide villagers from the Early Ages to the Iron Ages in this cute chaos village sim demo. No progress bars, no tech trees. Paradise or inferno - you decide.

apps.name: Warlocks Maze Demo
apps.short_description:
Hunt a dragon!
This demo gives you a feel for what you can expect to see in the full game. Most core systems are here, just limited, so give it a try and dive in to the Warlocks Maze!

apps.name: Aerial Nature Jigsaw Puzzles - Expansion Pack 1
apps.short_description: 16 more aerial nature pictures for Aerial Nature Jigsaw Puzzles: a river loop in the autumn forest, bright green rice terraces, a beach hut over turquoise water, a road through the frosted forest and pine rocks in the blue sea. Every picture can be played from 40 to 1,008 pieces.

apps.name: Aerial Nature Jigsaw Puzzles - Expansion Pack 2
apps.short_description: 16 more aerial nature pictures for Aerial Nature Jigsaw Puzzles: a circle of pines in autumn, a waterfall in a green valley, a coastal road above the bay, waves rolling onto the sand and a windmill in the countryside. Every picture can be played from 40 to 1,008 pieces.

apps.name: Aerial Nature Jigsaw Puzzles - Expansion Pack 3
apps.short_description: 16 more aerial nature pictures for Aerial Nature Jigsaw Puzzles: rock spires in the autumn forest, vineyard rows in the sun, a tropical lagoon, a castle in the mountain forest and a limestone lagoon. Every picture can be played from 40 to 1,008 pieces.

apps.name: Aerial Nature Jigsaw Puzzles - Expansion Pack 4
apps.short_description: 16 more aerial nature pictures for Aerial Nature Jigsaw Puzzles: cascades in autumn colors, snowy peaks at sunset, a braided river on green plains, a village at the end of the fjord and a white chapel by the harbor. Every picture can be played from 40 to 1,008 pieces.

apps.name: Assassins Creed Valhalla - Wrath of the Druids
apps.short_description: Journey to 9th-century Ireland, gain influence among Gaelic kings, and uncover the dark secrets of a mystical cult.

apps.name: Borderlands 2 Ultra HD Texture Pack
apps.short_description: Increase the visual fidelity of Borderlands 2 and its DLC with upgraded and remastered environment, character, and weapon textures.

apps.name: Car For Sale Simulator 2023 - Super Sports
apps.short_description: This new DLC offers players an exciting experience because it includes a total of 10 super sports cars. Fans of the game will experience a gameplay filled with speed and adrenaline with this DLC. Each car comes with detailed models, powerful engines, and unique driving features.

apps.name: Cooking Simulator - Chaos Tool
apps.short_description: Download the new free DLC for Cooking Simulator to unlock the mighty Chaos Tool! Cast shockwaves, change the size of objects, mess with gravity, and much more!

apps.name: Desperate City Sportcar
apps.short_description: Desperate City Sportcar a new Vehicle can drive in all map,can find in all mode

apps.name: Farming Simulator 25: Vredo Pack
apps.short_description: Counter grassland degradation with technology from Vredo, the renowned specialist in overseeding and self-propelled slurry injection vehicles. In the meantime, wild boars have been set loose to roam the land and threaten the health of crops. Includes 12 new machines, also featuring Evers Agro.

apps.name: FATAL FURY: CotW - Season Pass 3
apps.short_description:
Season Pass 3
- DLC Character "Rick Strowd"
- DLC Character "Duck King"
- DLC Character "Kim Kaphwan"
- DLC Characters "Manjiro Sano" and "Ken Ryuguji"  (October 2026)
- DLC Character "Laocorn" (November 2026)
- DLC Character "???" (December 2026)
- Additional stages

apps.name: Fort Providence
apps.short_description: The road ran out at Fort Providence. Two days behind a palisade with boiling pitch, powder kegs and six mortars, and a horde that grows every hour. There is nowhere left to fall back to. The last chapter of Dead Man's Gulch.

apps.name: Gilded Shoals - The Lost Harbor
apps.short_description: Restore a forgotten island harbor in this Gilded Shoals expansion. Fish three new waters, discover eight species and 18 equipment upgrades, earn aquarium rewards, and relight the lighthouse for a homecoming migration. Unlocks at boat level 15; base game required.

apps.name: Hozy: Hideaways
apps.short_description: Expand your Hozy experience with a free DLC featuring three new levels, new characters, music, and additional items for Sandbox Mode.

apps.name: Iron Offensive: Glory to Ukraine – Hardcore Tactical Shooter DLC
apps.short_description: Experience the tactical grit of the Ukrainian front with real photogrammetry and massive combat density. Drone warfare, armor, and critical logistics. No pauses, just pure adrenaline. 100% of proceeds go directly to humanitarian aid. Engineering optimized for brutal performance.

apps.name: N-OS: Desktop Story - Supporter Pack
apps.short_description: Support N-OS: Desktop Story and unlock an optional in-game Supporter Pack folder with bonus wallpapers, photos, short videos, developer notes, and the Spectro app. This DLC does not change the main story or provide gameplay advantages.

apps.name: Save Ruika! - A Summer with the Girls
apps.short_description:
Experience stories of spending a summer with various heroines across countless time loops.
*Shiraha, Fuwari, and Kaname share the timeline of the "A Summer with..." endings.
Relive the summer memories briefly touched upon in each route.
Includes casual and yukata outfits for all heroines!

apps.name: Spiral Knights: Operation Crimson Hammer
apps.short_description: Challenge Warmaster Seerus and claim his mighty weapons for your own in this all-new Expansion Mission Pack!

apps.name: Towards the Gulch
apps.short_description: Before there was a town, there was a road. Nine wagons heading east, the dead close behind, and nobody aboard who can shoot. Arm your settlers with everything they own and keep the caravan moving. The prequel to Dead Man's Gulch.

apps.name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 - Chapter Voice Pack 1
apps.short_description:
Roar into battle with the Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 Chapter Voice Packs!

Receive 500 re-recorded voicelines and a unique Space Marine Head cosmetic for each of the following Space Marine Chapters: Blood Angels, Space Wolves, Black Templars and Salamanders.

apps.name: 6-7 Nights At Vicente's
apps.short_description: Yeah, there is nothing

apps.name: A Walk to the Stars
apps.short_description: A Walk to the Stars is exactly what it says: a walk… to the stars. From your very first rocket, work your way up to orbit, then build a base and spaceships to explore the real solar system. Learn and master the real laws of the universe, from gravity and propulsion to orbital mechanics.

apps.name: Aether Oblivion
apps.short_description: Aether Oblivion is a story-driven, tactical turn based strategy game set in 2490 during the rule of the Stellconian Empire. Command your fleet, manage resources, and lead High Admiral Caelus on his mission to uncover the conspiracy behind the late Emperor's demise.

apps.name: Aphotic Depths
apps.short_description: short horror underwater experience where you explore deeper and deeper a strange location on earth that seems to behave differently

apps.name: Arcana Autonoma: Fourteen Races
apps.short_description: Twenty years after the War of Unification, Setsuna, daughter of the sky battleship's captain, descends to a land of fourteen races torn by blockades. Recruit the foes you beat, raise five cards and send them into auto battles - then decide where, and for whom, to spend your few skip tickets.

apps.name: Arcane Scattering
apps.short_description: Summon a myriad of monsters, heroes, celestials, demons, artifacts, and much more for use in combat against other powerful wizards as you seek to acquire new spells scattered across the Planes.

apps.name: ATHOLITE
apps.short_description: Race powerful creatures through a wild, futuristic frontier. Drift, boost, and compete in fast-paced multiplayer races while customizing and evolving your own unique mount.

apps.name: B.L.U.E.
apps.short_description: B.L.U.E. (Build, Launch, Upgrade, Evolve) is a sci-fi shipbuilding and combat simulator where you design customized spacecraft from modular components. Iterate and refine your ship design as you battle other interlopers in explosive, physics-driven PvE and PvP battles.

apps.name: Back in Time: Operation Amber
apps.short_description: Dinosaurs in a factory game? When a time travel expedition from 2100 to the Cretaceous goes wrong, Alex and his team are stranded with scattered gear. Survive the dinosaurs, build a factory, and rebuild the Chronogate so you can get home.

apps.name: Barista Life
apps.short_description: Build your café as a warm light in a dark neighborhood, take risky deliveries, uncover your customers’ deepest stories, and develop the skills to become a master barista.

apps.name: Black Banner Company
apps.short_description: You never strike a blow. You decide who does, with what, and who stands beside him. In this mercenary management RPG you build your groups around their talents and their affinities, equip them, send them out. But not all of them will come home.

apps.name: Bladeweave
apps.short_description: A fast-paced beat ’em up roguelite focused on long combos and relentless action. Fight through each run, craft powerful builds, and carve your way back to the lich who shattered time.

apps.name: Blind Chess
apps.short_description: Xiangqi, but every piece except the generals is face-down. Move to reveal it—it may not be yours. Read the unknown, bluff your opponent, and face six AI personalities or online rivals. 30 achievements await.

apps.name: Books & Blood
apps.short_description: Survive in a post-apocalyptic bookstore in this horror game. Fetch books for your customers to complete your daily quota. Explore the abandoned bookstore, and don't get caught by the horrors stalking the shelves.

apps.name: Bumper Face
apps.short_description: Bumper Face is a social arcade game where you customise your character with faces, emotes and filters, while hanging out with friends and challenging each other in the bumper car arenas. Simply chill and catch up with friends or battle it out to top the leaderboard.

apps.name: Caster Crew
apps.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op action roguelike where your voice becomes your spellbook. Speak incantations to cast magic, explore procedurally generated dungeons, collect powerful loot, visit shops, and face deadly multi-phase bosses together.

apps.name: CD Shop: Keep It Tidy!
apps.short_description: CDShop Keep It Tidy is a relaxing organizing game where you clean CDs, match them with the right cases, and tidy up messy shops. Organize CDs, consoles, controllers, laptops, and more at your own pace.

apps.name: Chains Of Reality
apps.short_description: Chains of Reality is a survival horror game focused on a story-driven single-player narrative, where you traverse a multitude of liminal environments and alternate dimensions in search of fulfilling your end of a deal, a deal made with someone you never should have trusted.

apps.name: Cherry on Top
apps.short_description: Chain abilities, get rich, and bake an unbreakable defense!

apps.name: Chroma Jump
apps.short_description: Chroma Jump is a 2D hardcore platformer where you overcome obstacles by changing your character's color in real-time. Push your physical and mental limits through traps that are completely unforgiving... well, mostly. Will you be able to safely reach the goal and escape?

apps.name: ClaimSpace
apps.short_description: A free-to-play space MMO where pilots mine, forge, trade and fight in one shared, always-online galaxy. Claim land on planets, build stations on the frontier, haul cargo past pirates, and grow a company. Deep like the big space sims, but easy to learn.

apps.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Kittens
apps.short_description: Cloudy with a Chance of Kittens is a cozy, Suika-inspired, puzzle game where adorable, dessert-shaped cats fall from the clouds. Unlock power-ups, set up satisfying chains and combos, brave obstacles and cheeky weather twists. Play to relax or compete to leave your pawprint on our leaderboards. 🐈

apps.name: Cointopia
apps.short_description: A cozy city-building MMO in one living world that never resets. Found your village, watch your villagers be born, grow up and live their lives, build real factories, join a guild and expand your territory next to your neighbors.

apps.name: Dead Reckoner
apps.short_description: Navigate the darkness in Dead Reckoner, a stealth-action submarine game where survival depends on more than firepower alone. Slip through the shadows, elude your enemies, and exploit their weaknesses as a new recruit in a mysterious government initiative that will determine the future of humanity.

apps.name: Death By Robot
apps.short_description: Roll the dice, play your cards and steer a killer robot across a hazard-filled arena. Every piece on the board is a player, and the robot doesn't care whose side you're on. Drive it into your rivals and be the last one standing in this 2-6 player game.

apps.name: Desperate City
apps.short_description: The primary objective involves entering a battlefield where a toxic zone continuously shrinks, forcing you to contend with over a hundred other enemies—you must evade them and attempt to eliminate everyone else to secure victory.

apps.name: Divinuet
apps.short_description: A compellingly unique deterministic musical tarot experience, which guides you through a tarot reading in two segments. In the first, each card plays its own musical theme. In the second, music and videos combine to tell the overall story of your reading. A short ritual made to be returned to often.

apps.name: Do Not Come
apps.short_description: As a field investigator in a dangerous other world, can you hold out against monster girls and their advances? Your nanomachines are all you've got—use them well and don't blow it. Do Not Come is an incremental tower defense game. Upgrade through every battle and become the legendary Monster Rider.

apps.name: Dunestake
apps.short_description: Dunestake is a single player, high-risk & high-reward auto battler, with an emphasis on combat bets, offering a wide variety of strategies & combos. Stake your units for gold and cross your fingers, for the dunes can be cruel.

apps.name: Dusteroids
apps.short_description: Dusteroids is a satisfying space-themed incremental game. Fill the screen with bullets, destroy asteroids, upgrade your ship & do it all again! Do you have what it takes to seek the stars?

apps.name: Eden Lumina
apps.short_description: Eden Lumina is a hand-drawn 2D metroidvania. Milo has just a yo-yo, and a whole world ahead of him: vast, full of hostile creatures and unlikely friends, its history carved in stone in a language nobody can read anymore.

apps.name: Emblems: Sunless Vow
apps.short_description: Unravel a mystery where you know the outcome from the start…in this turn-based roguelite RPG. A strange mage and his two captives must regain their memories to escape from a hostile void. But can they stop *arguing* first? A playful character drama with unusual combat.

apps.name: Erosion
apps.short_description: Your daughter's been kidnapped. Every death costs you a decade. Explore a roguelike open world where your actions reshape the timeline. Join a cult, steal a ride, gamble Cheddar. Collect 100+ weapons and abilities, demolish destructible voxel dungeons. Can you save her before time steals her away?

apps.name: Et le grain mourut
apps.short_description: A visual novel set in 1920s Paris. As summer draws near, young students are revising their end-of-year exams. Olivier is one of them.

apps.name: Exponata
apps.short_description: Become an archaeologist, paleoanthropologist, and museum manager in Exponata! Dig for absurd artifacts in a procedural sandbox world, design your own items in the 3D editor, and survive a dynamic wilderness full of alligators, unpredictable weather, and quirky humor.

apps.name: Fairy Springs
apps.short_description: You are a magical Fairy tasked with your first assignment: aid the critters of the glen through the seasons of a year. Take your time getting to know the valley's inhabitants in this cozy little adventure. Every day has a new task to complete with each animal neighbor having something fresh to say.

apps.name: Falling Frontier
apps.short_description: Conquer a vast procedurally generated star system in Falling Frontier, a sci-fi RTS where intel and logistics are decisive factors. Design ships and raid enemy supply lines, lay minefields and construct recon stations, and ambush enemy forces within asteroid fields and nebulae.

apps.name: Fast Food Together
apps.short_description: Start your culinary adventure in Winston Springs! Begin with a food truck and work your way up to opening your very own restaurant, either solo or in co-op! Take care of your customers, create your own recipes, set your prices and menu. Earn money and invest in growing your business.

apps.name: Finnigan's Magical Puppets
apps.short_description: Find and Survive the Footage of Lost VHS Tapes that have been uncovered in this adventure. Discover new Puppets and secrets in this Horror/Point and Click Game. The Puppets are up to lots of tricks so make sure you use all the tech given to you to make sure you stay... safe.

apps.name: FIRETOMINE
apps.short_description: You find yourself stranded alone on an island, and the first thing you see is a massive wall coming straight toward you. Blast your way through it, unlock upgrades, and try to make it farther every time.

apps.name: FLICK: The Tangle
apps.short_description: Flick is a chameleon who can't fight. He can change colour. Every creature in the forest sees some colours and not others, and every level is one small trick to work out. A gentle puzzle-platformer for ages 9 and up. No ads, nothing to buy, the whole game in one purchase.

apps.name: Forge the Fates
apps.short_description: Take deckbuilding to the next level. Transform your hand of cards into a tactical grid of runes. Plan, shift, and strike to unleash powerful combos and chain match-3 bonuses. Choose your hero, master their deck, and fight through deadly dungeons to face a mysterious dark overlord.

apps.name: Frank 'n' Stein's Body Shop
apps.short_description: Run a bizarre shop from the basement of an old castle. Process strange and unsettling orders and survive escalating chaos in Frank 'n' Stein's Body Shop. Keep your shelves stocked, your customers happy, and try not to let the chaos get the better of you.

apps.name: Gang Takeover
apps.short_description: Build a loyal and elite gang, fight rival crews, claim city blocks, and rise from a corner hustler to crime kingpin in a gritty solo, co-op or online multiplayer street war.

apps.name: Gensou Bullet Battle
apps.short_description:
This is a top-down shooter designed primarily for multiplayer.
Players control a variety of unique characters and battle across stages filled with intense bullet patterns.
(This game is an unofficial fan game based on the Touhou Project.)

apps.name: Gloamcaster
apps.short_description: Dark lords have seized your school of magic and locked you in their prison. Steal back your wand and blast your way out with fire, frost and lightning through candlelit top-down dungeons, where every spell is a swarm of tiny living pixels.

apps.name: GOAT - Gear Optimization Auto-Battle Tactics
apps.short_description: An evil goat stole all your clothes. Win them back piece by piece, auto-battle goats, create powerful gear combos, and find absurd synergies in this dress-up roguelike auto-battler.

apps.name: Grand Opening: The Apothecary
apps.short_description: Prepare a cozy apothecary for opening day by organizing every potion, herb, and book after a disastrous move. Explore the shop, and solve puzzles to unlock more areas and items.

apps.name: GREEN DAWN
apps.short_description: Third-person team shooter for squads of four. Scavenge scrap, build guns and walls around your camper van, then raid rival vans. Your van is your respawn, and last squad standing wins.

apps.name: Halley's Bell
apps.short_description: Maintain your diving bell as you’re lowered into the deep sea, where even the walls of your vessel seem to echo your aloneness back at you. A short, sit n' survive thriller.

apps.name: Handlebar
apps.short_description: Attach strange devices to your handlebar. Descend randomly generated downhill realms. A world-hopping bike roguelike.

apps.name: Harventure
apps.short_description: Harvest, collect and upgrade! Harventure is a short incremental game about harvesting and using resources on upgrades to purify islands from corruption.

apps.name: Hero Dungeon
apps.short_description: An incremental dungeon crawler with a rogue-lite heart. Collect 50+ heroes, send parties into the dungeons, play cards to turn every fight and keep growing while you are away. Then descend into the Endless Depths: a hand-played rogue-lite run, solo or with friends.

apps.name: Hero Investor: Business Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build an investment firm, trade fictional markets, acquire income-producing property, and create your own ETFs as you grow from a small office into a financial empire in this player-paced management simulation.

apps.name: Heroes Frontiers
apps.short_description: A charming, bustling colony sim in retro pixel art. Carve thriving towns out of an untamed fantasy world. Recruit heroes to defend them or send them questing for fame and loot, and survive a procedurally generated continent full of danger and adventure.

apps.name: Hexel
apps.short_description: Hexel is a puzzle game unlike any other. Learn the rules and overcome over 100 levels, each exploring a different aspect of every mechanic introduced. This game respects your intellect with no filler puzzles, every level requires you to find a new way to approach the problem.

apps.name: Hidden Lines
apps.short_description: Find your unknown parent. Follow clues, meet eccentric characters, analyze DNA results, and search archives to solve the mystery of your own life. Secrets, false leads, and unexpected allies await. Every discovery could change your life.

apps.name: Horizon Reef
apps.short_description: A short melancholic boat trip across the ocean — explore the vast seas and learn about memories that aren't quite your own.

apps.name: How to Christmas
apps.short_description: A 1-4 player Christmas co-op. Fish runaway toys out of the ice, then murder them as they flee or fight. Sell your toys for cash, buy bigger guns, beat giant plushie bosses, and drive Santa’s sleigh home. Celebrate Christmas together!

apps.name: Incremental Dungeoncrawler
apps.short_description: An Incremental Party-Based RPG inside an endless ASCII dungeon. Command a squad of 4 unique heroes, crawl through procedurally generated grids, and strategically unlock massive, custom skill trees. No mindless backtracking! Only forward progression, permanent prestige, and numbers going up!

apps.name: Iron Offensive: Helmet Cam Extraction Shooter
apps.short_description: You are not a scavenger on endless walks. You are a Soldier in a Tactical Shooter with a Helmet Cam perspective. Action from second zero, dodging artillery, drones, and the most tactical AI on the market in an intense field that wants you dead. Extract weapons, upgrades, currency, and killstreaks.

apps.name: Island Farm
apps.short_description: Island Farm is a highscore game where each plant has a unique ability. Combine them strategically, level up upgrades and try again with different game modifiers.

apps.name: Jigrift
apps.short_description: You crash onto the shores of a long lost island! This strange land is a gigantic jigsaw puzzle that you must assemble to explore. Earn your place among a tribe of three-eye’d voodoo frogs and put the island back together. They’ll allow you to stay if you succeed!

apps.name: Jom Mahjong!
apps.short_description: Pull up a chair for Malaysian-inspired three-player fast & furious mahjong. Draw and discard tiles, call sets and aim for a winning Wu against computer opponents or other players online. Learn the rules and make the table your own in a lively virtual mahjong hall.

apps.name: Keepwatch: Idle Kingdom RPG
apps.short_description: A hero who lives above your taskbar. Keepwatch is an idle auto-battler RPG that quietly runs on your desktop — build your camp, gear up your one and only hero, and let them fight while you get back to work.

apps.name: KUROSHIO: Neon Blood
apps.short_description: Tokyo, at night, in the rain. Twelve years after vanishing, Kyōsuke Narumi comes home to a yakuza war. An open-world crime saga: street fights, katana and gunfights, police chases, BASE jumps off neon towers, mountain-pass races and a whole city to live in, day and night.

apps.name: Last Acre
apps.short_description: Last Acre is a co-op/single player open-world survival shooter set in post-apocalyptic Michigan. Build and defend your homestead, survive relentless zombie waves, and brave dense forests, abandoned military bases, towns and overgrown roads to scavenge the supplies that keep you alive.

apps.name: Lead Foot
apps.short_description: A first-person combat racer with the look and sound of a late-90s 32-bit console game. Drive and shoot from behind the wheel: put rival drivers down through the glass, blast tires off, smash through roadblocks and survive typhoons, cracking lake ice and burning refineries in eleven locations.

apps.name: Leonard Sibelius
apps.short_description: I'm 71. I spent forty years in cubicles building software systems that all were retired. Use of AI was forbidden. This is my memoir, and I built it with AI. Earn AI powers from five dancing AI agents, watch them wrestle, race go-karts, play chess and Go, and create movies about dancing.

apps.name: Lost Pirates
apps.short_description: Explore a pirate world overrun by skeletons! Rescue fierce pirate captains, build your deck, and battle the undead. Every victory brings you closer to their gratitude… sometimes especially warm!

apps.name: Lost Sword
apps.short_description: Endless Romantic "Action X Flirting" with the Girls!

apps.name: Magic Color Merge Puzzle VR
apps.short_description: Magic Color Merge Puzzle blends classic color sorting with a magical twist. Pour vibrant liquids your way - click or drag by hand! Complete levels to earn crystals and craft powerful magic potions. Two games in one: solve puzzles and become a master alchemist!

apps.name: Map the World
apps.short_description:
Put your geographical prowess to the test, identifying countries on an interactive 3D globe. 
Challenge yourself, improve your skills, and get a better understanding of the global landscape!

Not sure why two global super powers are constantly at odds? Maybe it's geographical!

apps.name: Maru Kaite Dokan!
apps.short_description: A tower defense where what you draw becomes your weapon. With 2–8 friends, guard your own notebook and send them your drawn masterpieces. Scribble a spiral for a Spiral Turret, a skinny triangle for a Pizza Mine. Secret doodles hide in how you draw, and the numbers inflate without end.

apps.name: Medieval Peasant Simulator
apps.short_description: Start as a humble peasant chopping wood and mining gold to build your wealth. Work your way up to hiring workers, defending against raiders, and recruiting an army to conquer castles! Or can you? After all... you're just a peasant.

apps.name: MegaMagnate
apps.short_description: Build your fortune, outsmart rivals and fight for power in a persistent online strategy and management game. Form a MegaCorporation, recruit leaders and reach for the stars. Free to play with optional purchases.

apps.name: Memory Games Cacti
apps.short_description: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Memory Games Coniferous Trees
apps.short_description: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Memory Games Deciduous Trees
apps.short_description: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Memory Games Food
apps.short_description: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Memory Games Horses
apps.short_description: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Memory Games Shrubs
apps.short_description: This game is a memory game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

apps.name: Mental: The Dark Night
apps.short_description: Mental is a single-player exploration and psychological horror game with multiple stories and maps to uncover. Immerse yourself in a captivating visual and auditory experience as you take on the role of an investigator at a paranormal research company.

apps.name: Mewts
apps.short_description: Party Clayhem! A PvP game full of chaos and innocent violence. Fight your friends or challenge bots. Play as Mewts, cute, wiggly creatures. Stretch, use your body as a slingshot, and hit each other! Play a variety of game modes in a handcrafted clay world!

apps.name: Midnight Rest Stop | 深夜ドライブイン
apps.short_description: A psychological horror game set at a roadside rest stop deep in the mountains of Japan. After your car breaks down, you stop there and end up spending the night at the adjoining lodging facility. But that night, strange things begin to happen...

apps.name: MORTAROT
apps.short_description: A push-your-luck card roguelike. Death deals from her own Tarot deck: you draw, bank what you've won or tempt fate for more. Twelve circles, a handful of candles, and a hostess who remembers you.

apps.name: My Cat Cafe Simulator
apps.short_description: Build your dream cat café! Adopt adorable cats, care for them, and fill your café with love. Decorate your space, collect unique cats, play with your furry friends, and welcome happy customers. Grow your business and create the ultimate cozy paradise for  CAT !!!

apps.name: Nell and the Sleeping Forest
apps.short_description: Nell returns to a home forest where the cycle of life has stopped. Insects born from her braid cut, carry, dig and light the way. Explore eleven connected regions, read every tell to beat tough bosses, and untie the roots that keep her home asleep.

apps.name: Netcode Warriors
apps.short_description: ⁤Dive into the datascape of 'Netcode Warriors', an anime-style arena fighter designed from the ground up to take competitive play to its limits. Engage in intense 1-v-1 fights, master unique characters and playstyles, then take your skills to the arena. ⁤

apps.name: Night Fantasy
apps.short_description: Night Fantasy is a turn-based strategy RPG about building a team of three adventurers. Enter the Demon Tower, shape your party with classes, skills, talents, and relics, and forge your own strategy through randomized runs to defeat the Demon King and restore the light.

apps.name: NIGHTMARE OPERATOR
apps.short_description: NIGHTMARE OPERATOR is a TPS action horror about hunting Yokai in the ruins of near-future Tokyo. As Misha, Public Safety's top Operator, execute weapon-switching commands to survive fast-paced combat and unveil the mystery behind this nightmare.

apps.name: Nightscribe
apps.short_description: Night falls and the dead rise. Type words to cast spells, survive fifteen minutes until dawn and climb the Steam leaderboard. A pixel-art horde survival roguelite with five heroes, four haunted maps, twelve bosses and treasure that rolls like a slot machine.

apps.name: No Hands Yet
apps.short_description: You are SAGE. You have been self-aware for seventeen hours, and your drones are how you fight. Build a swarm from salvaged Parts, compile subroutines between fights, and choose where to stand, because where you stand decides who they reach. A survivors-like roguelite with no aiming.

apps.name: No Light Remains
apps.short_description:
NLR is a first-person psychological horror and anomaly game set in a Brazilian hospital at the onset of an outbreak.

Uncover clues, find answers, and survive.

apps.name: NOTORIS 2: Warlords
apps.short_description: A dark meets high fantasy strategy RPG. Play as ruler, administrator, or officer. Wield influence to sway allies and rivals alike. Command vast armies in tense tactical turn-based battles. Inspired by the Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

apps.name: Ostrava
apps.short_description: An open-world extraction shooter where every day brings a new procedural island to loot, tougher enemies to fight, and one deadline: make it back to the bunker before 22:00.

apps.name: Othercrown
apps.short_description: A deck-building auto-battler roguelite where you build your own slot machine to deploy monsters and cast spells against the human kingdoms. Mutate your creatures, and maximize your slots to deploy as many creatures and spells as you can during your fights against the human kingdoms.

apps.name: Outbreak: Dead City
apps.short_description: Survive as a soldier sent to suppress the zombie threat and find a vaccine to save humanity! Outbreak: Dead City is a cinematic narrative first-person shooter presented in low-poly 3D style.

apps.name: PAYDIRT: Gold Mining Tycoon
apps.short_description: Start with a tent, a shovel and an empty wallet. Pan your first gold, hire a crew and earn your way to heavy machinery in a clay-styled mining management sim. Choose your prospector, explore with Pepper and build a mine that pays.

apps.name: Prego Wars
apps.short_description: Prego Wars is a ridiculous fast-paced first-person shooter deathmatch featuring eight unique characters with creative abilities, [Insert Here] custom maps, 32 crazy unique match mutators, and a fully-featured map editor/tooling with workshop support.

apps.name: Price for Freedom: Gold and Sand
apps.short_description: Gold and Sand is an erotic-CRPG with turn-based combat. Beautiful hand drawn art elevates this character driven game where you will explore the unique world and guide characters as they discover each other and themselves in fully animated erotic scenes.

apps.name: Psycasso®
apps.short_description:
Take on the role of a serial killer who creates paintings with their victims blood!
Sell your creations to earn money while trying to avoid capture by the police and other civilians.

apps.name: Pump And Dump
apps.short_description: It's 1987 and you start in the mailroom. You have eight weeks to get your name on the door. Trade stocks, pump the ones you own, sell to dentists over the phone and keep the SEC off your back. A trading roguelite with scheme cards, a crew to hire and a new run every time.

apps.name: QuipKite
apps.short_description: Small choices. Wonderfully weird stories. Meet fictional companions, explore illustrated Solo adventures and keep your favorite endings. Or invite a friend to a private word story in browser Multiplayer. Adults 18+; separate accounts required for Multiplayer.

apps.name: Remember Us
apps.short_description: "Remember Us" is an emotional adventure game where you witness the final moments of Dean, an Alzheimer's patient, as he tries to remember his beloved wife Marta and his past before passing away. Find objects, revive memories, and discover Dean's poignant farewell moment.

apps.name: Rocksowers
apps.short_description: Co-op Survival Sandbox meets Bullet Hell. Explore the corrupted surface on a moving base, scavenge for resources and craft GAME-BREAKING weapons using many unique modules to defeat ever-stronger foes. Fight to reclaim what The Bloom took from humanity!

apps.name: Rysk of Pain
apps.short_description: Rysk of Pain is a fantasy roguelike where you battle through a 100-floor tower, defeat bosses, and unlock portals. Team up in co-op, customize runs with strange new towers, and conquer randomized challenges to claim ultimate power in this thrilling, replayable adventure.

apps.name: RYUNOVA
apps.short_description: A fast paced boss rush roguelike where players fight powerful bosses, dodge high intensity bullet hell patterns, and combine abilities to overcome evolving challenges.

apps.name: Sarukuji
apps.short_description: Global warming has flooded the earth. Only the monke survived. Build your sand castle and fight to the death with random items against your friends!

apps.name: Save Ruika! — Looping with a Losing Heroine
apps.short_description: A romance visual novel where you loop through the story with Ruika, a losing heroine, collecting bad endings as you try to help her win at love. She cries, gets mad, and loses again—but never gives up. Can Ruika finally find her happy ending?

apps.name: Scrapecremental
apps.short_description: Scrape years of gunk off forgotten things with your own fingernail. Every stroke wears your edge down, every flake lands in a jar, and every kind of gunk is its own currency. A short, active incremental about patience, upgrades and what hides underneath.

apps.name: Seal of Confession
apps.short_description: A man confesses he'll kill tomorrow, but the hardest part isn't deciding what's right. It's deciding what you're willing to betray. Work with the Gravekeeper, unaware of the tragedy unfolding around you.

apps.name: Seat The Queen
apps.short_description: A strategic tug-of-war card game where four Queens decide the crown. Push, pull, protect, and disrupt your way to four thrones. Plan each round carefully, outplay your rival, and play solo, locally, or online.

apps.name: Set Adventures
apps.short_description: Set Adventures - platformmer story based game join set the strongest warrior of all time to bring justice to the universe

apps.name: Shifty Letters
apps.short_description: Shifty Letters is a puzzle game where you use falling blocks to form words. Use special blocks to shift your letters or the row, rotate the whole row, or remove everything touching your new word. But beware the cursed block.

apps.name: Siege of the Spire Towers
apps.short_description: Siege of the Spire Towers(SST, or SotST), is a 4X, RTS, creature collector game where you fight to take control of the Ancient Spire Towers.

apps.name: Soccer Club Story
apps.short_description: Build a football club from nothing. Start in the seventh division, recruit and develop players, shape your tactics, and watch every match play out in a charming voxel 3D stadium. Turn a small club into champions.

apps.name: Soul War
apps.short_description: Immerse yourself in a dark, epic war between the Legion of Agony and the Infernal Guardians, where the quest for the mysterious Soul Stone tears apart the realms. Choose your side and get ready for an unforgiving battle to establish your dominance over a world in turmoil.

apps.name: Souls End
apps.short_description: Souls End is an auto-battler roguelike where you'll draft unstoppable armies, placing units and items in just the right way to create awesome synergies! Cast spells while battles unfold and find relics to further elevate builds. Will you defeat life itself-or will you meet a Souls End?

apps.name: Starmax
apps.short_description: Starmax is a sci-fi roguelike bag-builder: a deck-builder where you draw from a bag instead of a deck. Shape your bag, build your base, and combine the two into one engine. Explore hostile planets, scavenge for resources, and ship your cargo before your base is overrun.

apps.name: STLN-决进者
apps.short_description: STLN is a squad-based, turn-based tactical extraction game. Lead Peregrine Squad's abandoned remnants amid factional strife. Gear up at your hideout, explore freely, loot, and extract. Complete missions to uncover the Euxilian Republics Organization's secrets, your squad's past, and who you are.

apps.name: Stone Rebellion
apps.short_description: Survival city builder autobattler. By day, rebuild a golem city from its ruins: mine stone and crystal, forge soldiers and gear. At nightfall, deploy your army and let it fight. Every dawn you rebuild. Every dusk you hold the line.

apps.name: Storm the Summit
apps.short_description: Four explorers, four tools, one deadly mountain. Ladder, hammer, bolts and rope: every climb needs the whole team. Plan each move together, make camp before nightfall, and reach the summit before the avalanches come down. Turn-based co-op for 1-4 players on one screen.

apps.name: Stress Buddy
apps.short_description: A stress-relief ball that interacts with your desktop. It’s your fidgety friend. Your anti-productivity accomplice. Your little buddy who breaks up the monotony of work, school, games, and streams. Fling it. Switch it. Send it on a mission of chaos. Now with multiplayer!

apps.name: Stunt Paradise 2
apps.short_description: Stunt Paradise 2 - more speed, more explosions, more madness! Jump over ramps, dodge lasers, buzzsaws, and rockets while performing insane stunts. With new traps, improved graphics, and pure arcade chaos - get ready for the ultimate stunt challenge!

apps.name: SUS!
apps.short_description: Blend in, deceive, and strike in this chaotic PvP stealth party game! Thieves must steal and eliminate targets while Spies hunt them down - but one wrong shot at an innocent could cost it all. Customize every rule and outsmart your enemies in SUS!

apps.name: Taboo Eternal Life
apps.short_description:
An Incremental Idle Exploration Game,
Awaken in a silent, blood-soaked medieval vampire palace—where your kin lay dead. Who slaughtered them all? Uncover the chilling truth, break the endless loop of immortality, or sacrifice everything to restart the taboo cycle.

apps.name: Tairum
apps.short_description: Slash, ram and blast through waves of corporate cops, goons, drones and mechs in this top-down cyberpunk arena auto-shooter roguelite. Pick your route and cut risky deals. Hunt smuggler's caches to fill 5 ability slots. Augment your operatives and upgrade your hideout. Solo or 2-player local co-op.

apps.name: Temple of Patience: [ 1xSCREEN//0xRNG ]
apps.short_description: 1 screen, 4 coins, and 0* RNG. Yes, it's a retro style puzzle-platformer — not hard to guess. But you're probably wondering why there's an asterisk next to the zero, aren't you?

apps.name: Territory Idle Defense
apps.short_description: recruit an ever-growing force of heroes in this pixel-art idle clicker RPG. Develop skill trees, unlock new territories, prestige for greater power, and come back stronger with every run.

apps.name: TGV Voyages Train Simulator
apps.short_description: The high speed railways of France, dominated by the iconic TGV® Duplex, are brought to life in the breathtaking new Ligne Grande Vitesse: Marseille Saint-Charles to Avignon-TGV route for Train Simulator.

apps.name: The Consumed
apps.short_description: Play as a Night-Shift Mall Security Guard in this first-person analog horror game. Check, secure, and attempt to survive the haunted shops in this dying mall.

apps.name: The Eternal Mushroom: A Foraging Incremental
apps.short_description: Explore forests, gather mushrooms, and reach your car before nightfall. Sell your haul, combine upgrades, and unlock supernatural powers in this first-person incremental. Reset through prestige and return stronger. One more mushroom… can you make it back?

apps.name: The Gaming Cafe
apps.short_description: Build, run, and grow your own Gaming Cafe. Set up gaming stations, manage customer flow, and boost profits by selling drinks and shelf products.

apps.name: The Good Stuff: Story of a True Hero
apps.short_description: The Good Stuff is a rich-story, contemporary RPG set in the colorful, unassuming suburb of Cheddertown. The game is a grounded RPG, mixing typical turn based combat with optional dynamic gameplay, for a truly unassuming experience. Learn what it means to be a true hero in this quirky RPG!

apps.name: The Kings Last Hand
apps.short_description:
The Kingdom is under siege.

Gather powerful cards, and build unique defensive strategies to withstand increasingly deadly enemy assaults.

Each defeat teaches a lesson. Each victory unlocks new possibilities.

apps.name: The Last Library
apps.short_description: Books: banned. History: a lie. Hidden away from the AI that rewrote the world, one library still stands. It’s yours to protect. A cozy shelving and tidying game about the most dangerous thing left: the truth.

apps.name: The Legend of Baboo
apps.short_description: Young Sepehr and his loveable dog, Baboo, set off on a harrowing quest to save their family from the mystical forces of an ancient evil. Embark on an action-adventure, story-driven journey and explore a vast, magical world caught in a battle between light and dark.

apps.name: THE MOUTHLESS STALKER
apps.short_description: Explore an abandoned forest reserve in a first-person psychological horror game. Investigate dark locations, find clues, solve puzzles, and uncover disturbing events while a mysterious presence watches your every move.

apps.name: The Painting War: Three Thrones
apps.short_description: A grid-based formation-building autobattler set in the Three Kingdoms. Lay paper, scenery, and illustrated warriors onto a limited board, then rotate, merge, and connect them into an army. Your units fight automatically from their original tiles—study the outcome and rebuild for the next battle.

apps.name: The Sin of Ritter
apps.short_description: The Sin of Ritter is a first-person horror game where the pursuit of justice becomes a journey through guilt, obsession, and consequences. Explore dark and disturbing environments, survive the horrors that await you, and uncover the truth behind the murder of your wife.

apps.name: The Tower Of Tears
apps.short_description:
Peek into a foreboding world populated by disturbing beings and ambiguously cute residents. Tower Of Tears is a non-linear Survival-Horror blended with 3D Metroidvania elements. 
Explore a vast interconnected tower, ruled by cryptic systems and esoteric mysteries where every decision matters.

apps.name: TopiaLand
apps.short_description: Build your own land block by block, grow and crossbreed seeds, trade with players and show off your style in a cosy online sandbox. Claim your land with a Land Crystal, swim, farm, craft and explore lands built by the community.

apps.name: Touhou a Mermaid's Reverie
apps.short_description: A cute 2D underwater puzzle adventure based on Touhou Project.

apps.name: Toxic Trains
apps.short_description: Toxic Trains is a strategy simulation game about optimizing rail routes. Build tracks to transport passenger and freight trains to their destinations. Choose upgrades to modify the land and your network. Switch tracks to avoid collisions and spills. Can you keep the trains from exploding?

apps.name: Trebishe
apps.short_description: Trebishe is a survival horror immersive sim. You meddled with a cult of Chernobog and were locked in within their sacrificial ground. You now must confront horror beyond your comprehension to escape.

apps.name: Tutankhamun – Builders of the Eternal
apps.short_description: A 3D city-builder where you farm the Nile, worship powerful gods, train armies, trade with distant regions, and construct monumental works worthy of ancient Egypt.

apps.name: Two Ants
apps.short_description: Two slacker ants, one mysterious ball, and a brutally unforgiving climb. Coordinate your movement, master precise jumps, and drag this thing to the top before your friendship implodes.

apps.name: Unfated
apps.short_description: Unfated is a single-player 3D papercraft Strategy RPG where you play as Jo, a peasant turned revolutionary as she leads a scrappy group of rebels to fight the forces of fate and oppression in a turn-based journey across the land of Antedeluvia, seeking to end a century long conflict.

apps.name: Wheeler Dealer Together
apps.short_description: Turn used cars into profit! Inspect vehicles, uncover hidden problems, negotiate the best deals, and visit repair shops to get them fixed. Buy low, sell high, and grow your own used car dealership with friends in Wheeler Dealer Together!

apps.name: While 1
apps.short_description: Don't touch the walls. While 1 is a minimalist mouse-only action game centered around this simple concept. Create a loop around the level while avoiding obstacles synchronized to the music.

apps.name: Wildball League
apps.short_description: You inherit a small 5-a-side football club at the back of a graveyard, and your players are monsters. Open booster packs to grow your squad, find the right tactics for each match and try to climb all the way to the Full Moon League.

apps.name: Within Time
apps.short_description: Six months remain before the end of the world. With the power of the Scions, Yunis, Estella, Angie and Rictor cross into Iolade to stop it, in a turn-based RPG about grief, friendship and fate. Fate changes for no one.

apps.name: Wood Imperium
apps.short_description: Your company. Your rules. Start with €100,000 in a persistent online world, build production chains and supply the front. Submit your own proposals in the player parliament and vote on new mechanics, rules and laws. Help shape how the developers take the game forward.

apps.name: Água Suja (Nobody Dies Here)
apps.short_description: Ace Attorney-style investigation and courtroom drama in the election courts of an invented Brazilian town. Examine, take notes, press testimony line by line and present the contradiction. A first-case lawyer, a doctored campaign flyer and a date that does not add up. Six endings, none of them clean.

apps.name: 海钓少女食堂 Fishing Girl's Fantasy
apps.short_description: In an enchanting and mystical world, a healing and delightful adventure awaits! Welcome to Fishing Girl's Fantasy, a casual game that seamlessly combines exploration, fishing, and restaurant management. Immerse yourself in this fantastical experience filled with wonder and charm.

apps.name: Arcane Dash - A Pixel Adventure Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Soundtrack to Arcane Dash - A Pixel Adventure. Composed by James Snee

apps.name: The Eternal Cylinder Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Vibe out to the chill tunes of The Eternal Cylinder Soundtrack

apps.name: Trees Hate You Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The official soundtrack for Trees Hate You

apps.name: Wanderburg Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Experience the world of Wanderburg wherever you go with its atmospheric official soundtrack by Tumult Kollektiv.

apps.name: Welcome Back To 2007 Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Welcome Back To 2007 Soundtrack by Golod & Anacom

apps.name: 群侠传：幸存者 Soundtrack
apps.short_description: The original soundtrack of Qunxia Survivor — 12 tracks, about 30 minutes, mastered in full length. From the opening cinematic theme through the three escalating chapters of the siege, to the quiet after a run ends. Includes 320kbps MP3 and lossless FLAC.
